name: Borias
description: A competitive Alamon soldier who is inseparable from Bardas; he dies beside him, joking about their bet.

timeline.summary: Ten soldiers of the Alamon wait at the Horns for Eumalos's squad, and Captain Kyrillos sends Bardas and Borias to climb the stones.
timeline.quote: Bardas, Borias—climb the Horns and see what you can see.

timeline.summary: A wounded cyclops attacks the squad; Pallas is backhanded, and the squad kills it with Mnesos's sling and Nikasios's spear.
timeline.quote: There was a crack as Mnesos's stone met the cyclops's skull, and the creature roared.

timeline.summary: Borias dies beside Bardas, telling Leandros about their bet over who would live longer.
timeline.quote: He shuddered, and his eyes went glassy.

relations.note: Inseparable pair who compete with each other.
relations.quote: But they were undeniably a pair, and they liked nothing as much as competing with one another.

pages_say.description: A competitive Alamon soldier who is inseparable from Bardas; he dies beside him, joking about their bet.
